title.zh: 将北苏里高省Dinagat岛改设为独立的公路工程区的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting the Island of Dinagat in the Province of Surigao Del Norte Into a Separate Highway Engineering District
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Island of Dinagat in the Province of Surigao Del Norte Into a Separate Highway Engineering District

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5476_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Island of Dinagat in the Province of Surigao del Norte is hereby constituted into a separate highway engineering district to be known as the Island of Dinagat Highway Engineering District of the Province of Surigao del Norte. The office of said highway engineering district shall be located in the Municipality of Albor, Province of Surigao del Norte.

The Island of Dinagat Highway Engineering District of the Province of Surigao del Norte shall have a highway district engineer and such other personnel who shall be appointed in accordance with existing laws and regulations.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
